problem: A substring XML MIME check decoded binary Open XML Office ZIP archives as text, corrupting browser-proxy downloads.
change: Only explicit text, JSON, JavaScript, XML and structured +json/+xml media types are sanitized as text. Binary bodies are byte-preserved. Rewritten textual responses declare UTF-8 while retaining other MIME parameters.

verification.hosted: 20 Docs exports pass content/tab isolation and archive checks through patched proxy; complete captured native state unchanged.

limits: HTTP export verification does not establish browser download UI parity.
Full eight-provider parity and sample release gates remain incomplete.
